events.text: Co-founded the Nava Sama Samaja Party after leaving the LSSP

events.text: Suspended from the LSSP

evidence.quote: He was suspended from the LSSP in April 1999

events.text: Crossed over to the opposition in parliament

evidence.quote: A few days later Nanayakkara crossed over to the opposition in parliament

events.text: Formed the Left & Democratic Alliance party

events.text: Chosen as UPFA mayoral candidate for Colombo
